newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-FOREKS CONSIDERS TWO WAYS TO GO RUSSIA.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-FOREKS CONSIDERS TWO WAYS TO GO RUSSIA.

text.p: Forekspank has identified two ways how to expand its activities in Russia from its present representative office into commercial bank activities, Ivar Lukk, the chairman of the board, said on Monday.
"We have two possibilities: the first one is to gain control of an already existing bank and the second one is to register from zero," Lukk told Reuters.

"The third opportunity, to start operating as a foreign bank branch office, will disappear in the coming weeks as the Russian central bank new rules will ban the possibility to open a foreign bank branch office," he added.

Lukk in March told Reuters that Forekspank had chosen expansion into the Russian market as its main strategy of moving away from the small Estonian market. Other banks have chosen to expand into the markets of neighbouring Latvia and Lithuania.
But Forekspank does not know yet when it is going to expand from its present representative office into commercial bank activities, Lukk added on Monday.
"It is complicated and risky market, where decisions have to be considered very carefully," Lukk said.
Lukk said the representative office, which opened in March, has started to work normally.
"It plays the major role of giving analysis of the Russian market and consults Estonian and Russian clients," Lukk said.
